title: 폭풍우 항구의 밀수품 추적
description: 비바람이 몰아치는 동물 도시의 항구 창고에서 고양이 탐정단과 함께 다섯 가지 밀수품 단서를 찾아보세요.
theme: 고양이 탐정단의 폭풍우 치는 밤 항구 창고 밀수품 추적
scene: A whimsical animal-city harbor warehouse during a dramatic but cozy nighttime rainstorm, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle. Warm amber warehouse lamps glow against deep navy rain, with a moored cargo boat and distant lighthouse outside through a wide open loading door, and no readable signs. At the lower-left, the recurring friendly orange tabby detective cat wears a cream trench coat and navy deerstalker hat while examining clues; the cat holds one oversized brass magnifying glass with one large clearly visible turquoise-blue lens. On the upper-left brick wall, one prominent coral-red life preserver has exactly four broad cream bands, all clearly separated. At center, one large open wooden evidence crate contains exactly four upright emerald-green glass bottles arranged in one clear row. At the upper-right, one large brass cargo crane hook hangs from a thick rope and is painted bright signal red. In the lower-right foreground, the recurring friendly gray mouse assistant in a burgundy raincoat holds one closed golden-yellow umbrella with exactly one large blue five-point star charm hanging from its curved handle. Add a kind beaver dockmaster in a plain cap, stacked blank wooden crates, coiled ropes, puddle reflections, a brass scale, fish baskets, rain-streaked windows, and distant harbor lights only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the turquoise magnifying-glass lens, four cream life-preserver bands, four green bottles, red cargo hook, and blue star umbrella charm large, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, or numbers.
